programme.title: Daredevil
programme.desc: (2003) Marvel comicbook action. Blind lawyer Ben Affleck turns sonar-powered vigilante by night to battle super-villain Colin Farrell and romance ninja-assassin Jennifer Garner.

programme.title: The Missionary
programme.desc: (1982) British Connection. Michael Palin stars as a clergyman who returns from ten years in Africa in 1906 and has to find funding for a Mission for Fallen Women in London.

programme.title: Teleshopping
programme.desc: Teleshopping.

programme.title: Teleshopping

programme.title: Lifeboat
programme.desc: (1944) Alfred Hitchcock's Oscar-nominated Second World War drama starring Tallulah Bankhead, William Bendix and Walter Slezak as three of the survivors from a liner torpedoed by the Nazis.

programme.title: The Shepherd of the Hills
programme.desc: (1941) John Wayne stars as a moody young man living in the Ozarks who has sworn revenge on his long-absent father for deserting his mother. Then a kindly stranger appears on the scene...

programme.title: Guadalcanal Diary
programme.desc: (1943) Second World War action drama following two US marines as they make advances into the Solomon Islands to drive back the Japanese forces. Starring Preston Foster and Lloyd Nolan.

programme.title: Canyon Passage
programme.desc: (1946) Frontier western starring Dana Andrews. An ambitious businessman journeys to rural Oregon where a complex web of life and love waits to ensnare him. Directed by Jacques Tourneur.

programme.title: Charlotte Gray
programme.desc: (2001) World War II thriller. Cate Blanchett stars as a secret agent sent to occupied France to aid the Resistance against the Nazis. But she has her own agenda. With Michael Gambon.

programme.title: 12 Years a Slave
programme.desc: (2013) Chiwetel Ejiofor, Michael Fassbender and Benedict Cumberbatch star in Steve McQueen's Oscar-winning fact-based drama about the horrific reality of being a slave in 19th-century USA.

programme.title: Kingsman: The Secret Service
